text: Premise corrected before planning: the request was two status systems (combat + outside combat). StatusRuntime is already both -- it holds the 24 shipped combat statuses AND hosts out-of-combat projections (nerve.*, exhaustion.*, wound.*). The locked rule recorded 2026-10-02 in decisions/combat.md refuses a second runtime. Plan is therefore authoring surface + the missing drive, not an engine.

Measured, not assumed: StatusRuntime.Tick has exactly two callers (Effects/EffectBag.cs:858, Battle/BattleEngine.cs:456). NervePolicy.Sync has ZERO production callers (tests only); ExhaustionPolicy.Sync has exactly ONE, in the PvZ lawn (LawnExhaustionLifecycle.cs:93), behind an edge detector. The projection mechanisms are built and tested; the DRIVE is the gap. This is why ST1.4 exists.

Corrected a stale premise from my own earlier briefing: ActorHudResources.Meters DOES have a producer (ActorHudBuilder.cs:51-54, E41). Its meterId vocabulary is ResourceIds, so the conclusion holds -- a status can never publish a ratio -- but the claim 'no producer' was wrong and is not carried into any artifact.

K1 (seventh ResourceIds pool) is owner-only and genuinely undecided: resource-hub-ssot.md:134 says adding one is an ADR, and no ruling anywhere permits OR forbids it. Both routes have shipped precedent -- poise (2026-08-26) widened the pool; nerve (2026-09-05) and wound.* (2026-09-13) solved the same need as a projection. Packet default follows the projection precedent. ST2.1 blocked on K1; nothing else is.
Premise rejected: this repo is C#/.NET (FusionRpg, a PvZ-mode mod framework), not Godot. No project.godot anywhere. The Godot question does not apply and no artifact carries it.
